name: codex-micro-keypad
description: A Windows companion inspired by Codex Micro: task status, model controls and usage at a glance, without a virtual HID driver.

interface.longDescription: A Windows desktop companion inspired by Codex Micro. See task status, switch models and reasoning effort, check usage, and toggle Fast. Requires Windows x64, .NET 10 Desktop Runtime and a signed-in Codex desktop app; the current adaptation baseline is 26.930.3930.0. No Micro hardware or virtual HID driver is required. Independent third-party project, not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI or Work Louder.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open Codex Micro Monitor and show the available controls.
